name: SCU interest-free student loans
summary: Small interest-free loans, from $100 emergency loans to $1,500, for SCU students whose study is at risk from financial hardship.
key: Interest-free loans from $100 (emergency) up to $1,500, including a $1,000 placement loan.
who: Australian students, permanent residents and full-fee onshore international students enrolled in a Commonwealth-funded course at SCU.
Must show genuine need and that study is at risk because of financial hardship.
how: Book a student loan appointment through CareerHub.
numbers: $1,000, up to 8 months, repayments start 2 months after issue, guarantor needed
Up to $1,500, up to 10 months, guarantor needed
catches: First-time borrowers can borrow up to $500.
Level Five is only for students who repaid a Level Three loan on time.

evidence.quote: The University operates a Student Loan Scheme designed to provide small interest-free loans to currently enrolled students.
Student loans are not available to exchange students.
